pages.title: Description
pages.text: The chimera familiar can be fed any meat to grow, gaining damage and speed. Once it has grown big enough, its owner can ride it. Feeding it a $(item)golden apple$() detaches the $(#ad03fc)Goat$() as a separate familiar.$(br2)The detached goat familiar can be $()

pages.title: Description
pages.text: used to obtain the $(l:familiar_rituals/familiar_shub_niggurath)Shub Niggurath$(/l) familiar.$(br)

$(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$()$(br)When upgraded by a blacksmith familiar, the detached goat familiar gets a warning bell. Hitting the goat rings the bell and attracts enemies in a large radius. Chimera itself cannot be upgraded.$(br)
